[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Nomi Rhane''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Biologist/Legends|biologist]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We've barricaded ourselves in the maintenance room. There is an escape ladder here but the hatch is magnetically sealed.|Dr. Nomi Rhane, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:WN" />}}
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Dr. Nomi Rhane was part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Scientist/Legends|science]] staff in the [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. There, scientists were secretly conducting dangerous scientific research for the Empire, intending to re-engineer the dreadful [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] into a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]]. Dr. Rhane was a [[microbiologist]] who operated on level 2 of the research laboratory.<ref name="SWG:RFL1" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Nomi Rhane was present when an accident took place in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility and the virus [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|escaped]] containment. The virus killed most of the people in the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|area]], turning them into [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures. However, Dr. Rhane survived the outbreak and joined a small group of survivors including Dr. [[Stane Tritan]], Dr. [[Pram Dramango]], [[Marpo Glenfik]] and [[TK-217]]. The survivors barricaded themselves in a maintenance room with an access to an emergency escape ladder. They resisted the attacks of the undeads but they did not manage to open the magnetic hatch and were stuck in that room. A group of spacers finally entered the research facility. Following the indications communicated by Nomi Rhane, they successfully unlocked the hatch blocking the emergency exit.<ref name="SWG:WN" /> Furthermore, Dr. Rhane tasked the spacers with shutting down the facility ventilation to stop the spread of the virus outside the research center.<ref name="SWG:SV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Stupid Vents!|Dathomir}}</ref> The survivors and the spacer then used the escape ladder to leave the facility. Once arriving at the surface, in the courtyard of the Imperial Research and Prison Facility, they were indeed attacked by the undeads. The spacers escorted the survivors to [[Camp Epsilon]] located nearby, where a group of refugees and a functional [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] were awaiting them. The survivors, including Nomi Rhane, the spacers and the refugees of Camp Epsilon eventually escaped the Quarantine Zone together in the shuttle.<ref name="SWG:E">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Escape|Dathomir}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Nomi Rhane appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RFL1" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Nomi Rhane was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
